messages:
ops: FYI — during a customer load test hitting /v1/rerank we saw a p95 spike to ~1.8s and ~120 502/gateway timeouts starting at 14:03 UTC. Attaching a couple of request IDs we traced: req=ab12, req=cd34. dev-bot: Incident alert created (#inc-502-rerank).
maria: thanks — can you paste a sample request payload and any trace IDs you have?
ops: sample (sanitized) request:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-XXXX' 
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
 -d '{"query": "best restaurants near me", "candidates": ["id1","id2",...,"id400"], "top_k": 10}'
```
ops: headers show default client retries=3, client QPS ~120 during load test. No auth errors.
support-bot: Any billing or plan throttles triggered?
ops: checked billing logs — not rate limited. No quota rejects.
sam: sounds like a retry storm + backend queueing. Gateway will retry on 502 by default which can amplify bursts. Do we have gateway logs showing retry counts?
ops: grep shows many entries like `gateway: retry=2 backend=rerank-01 resp=502 lat=30ms` and a lot of `queue_full`/`batch_alloc_timeout` afterwards.
luis: also search for `kvcache` warnings — if large candidate lists cause frequent KV cache misses we can trigger GC/eviction pressure.
ops: found repeated `kvcache: eviction_threshold_exceeded` and `batch_alloc_timeout` at the same time as the 502s.
maria: repro hypothesis: large candidate arrays -> bigger batches -> longer model-side GC/alloc -> transient 502s -> client retries -> more load -> routing timeouts.
jen: short-term mitigations we can push: 1) Fail-fast at gateway when queue_full (return 429) 2) Add per-client concurrency / rate-limit policy for the test org 3) Recommend client set max_retries=0 or exponential backoff to avoid retry amplification 4) Suggest bounding candidates to 200.
sam: also consider enabling a cheap fallback model variant (smaller quantized) for high QPS routes and turning on autoscale headroom.
ops: I'll run a quick repro: reduce candidates to 150 and run the same QPS. Will attach traces.
ops: repro result — with candidates=150: p95 dropped to ~220ms, 5xxs disappeared. No `batch_alloc_timeout` entries.
maria: great — can you dump full traces for a failing run and the successful run to post to the postmortem? Include gateway trace IDs and model node IDs.
ops: attaching traces in follow-up thread. For now I'll advise the customer to cap candidates at 200 and disable aggressive client retries.
luis: we'll queue a config change to make route return 429/503 early under queue pressure and add an internal alert for `batch_alloc_timeout` > 5/min.
jen: noted, will coordinate the temporary rate-limit and communicate to the customer. :white_check_mark:
maria: thanks all — looks like clear action items: (1) customer guidance (cap candidates, reduce client retries) (2) gateway fail-fast policy (3) add alert for batch_alloc_timeout and kvcache evictions (4) evaluate autoscale/fallback model.
ops: thanks team, closing for now. Will post results of follow-up traces in #inc-502-rerank.
